description: plate with a linear pattern of ribs
prompt: Create a base plate named `base` of 150 mm (X) x 60 mm (Y) x 8 mm (Z) with a corner at the origin. On its top face, add 5 ribs, each 4 mm thick (X), 60 mm long (Y) and 15 mm high (Z). The first rib starts at x=10, the ribs are spaced 30 mm apart. `base` must be a single solid including the ribs.
